newsitem.title: USA: Chevron sees no impact from LPG leak.
newsitem.headline: Chevron sees no impact from LPG leak.

text.p: Chevron Corp said liquified petroleum gas (LPG) is flowing on a parallel line while crews on Tuesday bleed down a leaking pipeline near Dayton, Texas northeast of Houston.

The 10-inch pipeline, which flows into the Mont Belvieu, Texas complex east of Houston, began venting gas into the atmosphere when crews opened a bolt hole while cleaning a valve, a Chevron spokesman said
"There's not anticipated to be any problem right away (with deliveries)," the Chevron spokesman said. Flow rates on the line were not immediately available.
The leak forced the evacuation overnight of nearly 4,000 prisoners from a state prison complex seeking to escape the billowing cloud of highly flammable gas spewing through the opened bolt hole.
The prisoners were transported by bus to jails and a civic center in nearby towns because of the fear of an explosion, officials said.

Fire crews were spraying a steady stream of water on to the leak to reduce the possibility of ignition. The gas was expected to be vented and the line repaired by Tuesday afternoon, the spokesman said.
